items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Used to come down to my home, play music with the white folks, you know. ... I was with him.

ctx.x: And he had a grocery store in Chicago. Yeah, a big grocery store.

On Prairie Street. Prairie and 50 Fights I believe it was. Something like that. Did you know Bud Scott and that business? Yeah, I know them before I went to Chicago. Used to come down to my home, play music with the white folks, you know. What kind of a band did he have? Bass, guitar, and guitar. Yeah, I know them before I went to Chicago. I think he used to carry two violins. Bass, guitar, guitar, trumpet, but the guy had to play with a mule all night, you know. Soft music. What do you name too? Joe Gabriel, you…
Would the trumpet player play by ear or would he read?
